tools.name: find_bots
tools.description: Search Bot Matchmaker's rankings of consumer AI bots and agents for an everyday job (for example: fight a parking ticket, plan a trip, practice a language). Returns structured content: search_id, the matched category ({slug, name, page} or null), exact_match, browse_page, and results: up to 5 bots,

tools.name: get_bot
tools.description: Get one bot's details from Bot Matchmaker. Returns structured content with the same fields as a find_bots result, plus agent_note, website, app_store (links or null) and history: up to 6 weekly snapshots of app_store_stars, app_store_ratings and website_rank. On failure the result has isError true,

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List Bot Matchmaker's categories of everyday jobs. Returns structured content: categories, each with slug (usable as find_bots' category), name, page, examples, and top_bots: up to 3 of {slug, name, bot_matchmaker_page}. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "find_bots" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search Bot Matchmaker's rankings of consumer AI bots and agents for an everyday job (for example: fight a parking ticket, plan a trip, practice a language). Ret…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
